req.title: Reject negative skip
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the skip parameter is negative.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-006 requires HTTP 422 when skip < 0. The FastAPI endpoint uses Query(0, ge=0) which enforces skip >= 0. Tests must cover: (1) positive case — skip=0 returns 200, (2) negative case — skip=-1 returns 422, (3) boundary cases — skip=-1 (just below threshold, must fail), skip=0 (exact threshold, must pass), skip=1 (just above threshold, must pass). This covers BVA ±1 around the ge=0 boundary, EP for valid/invalid partitions, and NEG for the rejection path. The violation in test[3] was kind=negative with heuristic=EP — a negative test must use NEG (or BVA/DT) not EP. EP is reserved for positive partition representatives. Fixed test[3] to use heuristic=NEG since it exercises the invalid (negative) equivalence partition to confirm rejection.

tests.name: test_skip_zero_returns_200_with_all_tasks
expected: Response body is a list of 20 tasks
trace: R-TASK-006: valid skip=0 is in the ge=0 partition; must succeed
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)
r = client.get("/tasks/?skip=0")
assert r.status_code == 200
body = r.json()
assert isinstance(body, list)
assert len(body) == 20

tests.name: test_skip_negative_one_returns_422
expected: Response body contains validation error detail
trace: R-TASK-006: skip=-1 violates ge=0 constraint; system must return 422
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)
r = client.get("/tasks/?skip=-1")
assert r.status_code == 422
body = r.json()
assert "detail" in body
assert isinstance(body["detail"], list)
assert len(body["detail"]) >= 1
error = body["detail"][0]
assert "loc" in error
assert "skip" in error["loc"]

tests.name: test_skip_boundary_minus_one_vs_zero
trace: R-TASK-006: BVA ±1 around ge=0 threshold kills off-by-one and comparison-operator mutations
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

r_neg = client.get("/tasks/?skip=-1")
assert r_neg.status_code == 422

r_zero = client.get("/tasks/?skip=0")
assert r_zero.status_code == 200
body_zero = r_zero.json()
assert isinstance(body_zero, list)
assert len(body_zero) == 20

r_one = client.get("/tasks/?skip=1")
assert r_one.status_code == 200
body_one = r_one.json()
assert isinstance(body_one, list)
assert len(body_one) == 19

tests.name: test_skip_large_negative_returns_422
expected: Response body detail references the skip parameter
trace: R-TASK-006: any negative skip value is in the invalid equivalence partition; -100 is a representative interior point confirming the rejection rule applies across the entire invalid range, not just the boundary
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)
r = client.get("/tasks/?skip=-100")
assert r.status_code == 422
body = r.json()
assert "detail" in body
errors = body["detail"]
assert isinstance(errors, list)
assert any("skip" in str(e.get("loc", "")) for e in errors)

tests.name: test_skip_negative_does_not_return_200
actions: Assert status code is exactly 422, not 200 or any 2xx
trace: R-TASK-006: decision table row — skip < 0 → reject; this test explicitly rules out 2xx responses to kill mutations that suppress the validation guard
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)
r = client.get("/tasks/?skip=-1")
assert r.status_code == 422
assert r.status_code != 200
assert r.status_code != 201
assert r.status_code != 204
assert r.status_code != 400
body = r.json()
assert "detail" in body
assert body.get("detail") is not None
